numerical_failure.observed_behavior: After the 'premature overflow' fix, the new formulation for large lmbda*log(x) loses precision near lmbda≈0 and for x=1: boxcox(1, 10) returns -2.7755575615628914e-17 instead of 0; mpmath comparison fails with large relative differences (e.g. x=1e-30, lmbda=-3.4223003202678016e-08 gives -69.07763443514705 vs reference -69.07763444097992, rdiff 8.44e-11; assertion Max |rdiff| 3.7072e-07 with 76 of 1024 bad points).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: boxcox(x, lmbda) should match the mpmath reference (powm1(x, lmbda)/lmbda, log(x) at lmbda=0) to rtol=1e-13, and boxcox(1, 10) should be 0.
trigger_conditions: lmbda approximately 0 (small |lmbda| near the 1e-19 cutoff, with the new formulation used when lmbda*log(x) >= 709.78)
x=1 with nonzero lmbda, e.g. boxcox(1, 10)
large x (e.g. 8.98846567431105e+307) combined with small lmbda such as -1.05e-15 or 1.12e-15
x near 1e-30 combined with lmbda around 1e-8
